scope: Read-only replay of all three original SQL statements on the current unchanged database; not new model requests or a regrade

reference.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'canceled')  AS canceled
FROM orders;

actual.sql:
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_status IN ('delivered', 'canceled')
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status
LIMIT 10;
